note: Tracked entities for the intel/self-update loop, plus a curated `outlets` group = the per-field information landscape (portals · journals · preprint servers · databases/registries · repositories · media). `feed` URLs are best-effort canonical feeds; verify reachability with `harness refresh --provider feed --verify`. Outlets carry `outlet_kind` + `why` + `not_for` + `verified` + `access` (see `reference/outlet-map.md`). YouTube channels are resolved to their RSS via `resolve: youtube`.

outlets.name: CiNii Research
outlets.why: National Institute of Informatics index of Japanese-language articles, books and data.
outlets.not_for: Index metadata only; Japanese-language retrieval is required to use it well.

outlets.name: J-STAGE
outlets.why: Japan Science and Technology Agency platform hosting Japanese sci-tech society journals.
outlets.not_for: Mixed access and mixed language; many journals are society-run - appraise the specific title.

outlets.name: CNKI
outlets.why: China National Knowledge Infrastructure: the dominant index for Chinese-language journals and theses.
outlets.not_for: Full text is licensed and paywalled; coverage and censorship are opaque - corroborate important claims.

outlets.name: Wanfang Data
outlets.why: Chinese journals, dissertations and standards (ISTIC-affiliated).
outlets.not_for: Paywalled full text; a second Chinese index, not an independent verification of CNKI.

outlets.name: EThOS
outlets.why: UK doctoral theses, now delivered on a Hyku-based platform after the British Library outage.
outlets.not_for: Theses are examined but not peer-reviewed articles; check for a published paper.

outlets.name: Proceedings of Machine Learning Research
outlets.why: Free, citable proceedings for ICML, AISTATS and other ML conferences.
outlets.not_for: ML scope only; a proceedings paper is not a journal article.

outlets.name: SpringerLink
outlets.why: Springer Nature journals and books - the version of record for a large share of STM literature.
outlets.not_for: Largely subscription-gated; the landing page is not the article's evidence.

outlets.name: Cambridge Core
outlets.why: Cambridge University Press journals and books, strong in humanities and social sciences.
outlets.not_for: Largely gated; check the licence per article.

outlets.name: PLOS
outlets.why: Open-access publisher with a full search API (api.plos.org/search), usable from a script.
outlets.not_for: PLOS ONE is broad and volume-driven - appraise the specific article, not the brand.

outlets.name: DARIAH
outlets.why: The EU digital-humanities infrastructure: working groups, standards and training for computational humanities work.
outlets.not_for: A network, not a content repository - for data, follow the working-group outputs to their publishers.

outlets.name: Digital Scholarship in the Humanities
outlets.why: The flagship DH journal (OUP); peer-reviewed computational-humanities research.
outlets.note: host blocks automated checks (403); listed, not confirmed
outlets.not_for: Subscription-gated; the abstract may suffice for a first pass.

outlets.name: Journal of Cultural Analytics
outlets.why: Open-access journal for the computational study of culture; publishes data and code alongside articles.
outlets.not_for: Method-forward - for a domain question, start from the field's own journal.

outlets.name: Cognitive Science (journal)
outlets.why: The Cognitive Science Society's journal; the field's flagship for computational and empirical cognition.
outlets.note: host blocks automated checks (403); listed, not confirmed
outlets.not_for: Subscription-gated; for OA, pair with Open Mind and PsyArXiv.

outlets.name: Cognition (journal)
outlets.why: Elsevier's cognitive journal; dense, single-mechanism studies - a high bar for falsifiable claims.
outlets.note: host blocks automated checks (403); listed, not confirmed

outlets.name: Trends in Cognitive Sciences
outlets.why: Cell Press review journal; short, curated takes on where cognitive science is moving.
outlets.note: host blocks automated checks (403); listed, not confirmed
outlets.not_for: Reviews, not primary findings - follow the references to the studies.

outlets.name: Open Mind (journal)
outlets.why: MIT Press open-access journal for the sciences of mind; the OA alternative to the paywalled flagships.
outlets.note: host blocks automated checks (403); listed, not confirmed

outlets.name: Chinese Text Project (中國哲学書电子化)
outlets.why: Open-access digital library of pre-modern Chinese texts with a documented API (ctext.org/tools/api, JSON-RPC + data-writer). Site and API docs both 200 on probe 2026-10-28. Primary door for the 古籍整理 worked example in reference/tool-router.md.
outlets.not_for: Not a critical edition database - readings vary in provenance; cross-check against a second witness (CBETA / NLC scans) for collation work.

outlets.name: CBETA 電子佛典基金會 (XML-TEI corpus)
outlets.why: Digitized Chinese Buddhist canon (大正藏/卍續藏/嘉興藏 etc.) as TEI P5 XML; rolling releases (2026.R2, 2026-08). Site 200 on probe 2026-10-28; online reader cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw cert-failed from this network (unverified here). Attribution-based license.
outlets.not_for: Buddhist canon only - for dynastic histories use ctext/中華古籍資源庫; community MCP wrappers are untrusted reads until source-audited (M6.11).

outlets.name: China Biographical Database (CBDB)

outlets.name: BDRC / BUDA (Buddhist Digital Resource Center)
outlets.why: 28M+ pages of Buddhist documents (Tibetan/Sanskrit/Chinese) with IIIF + open linked data per the official site. SSL handshake failed from this probe (2026-10-28) - listed by official URL, reachability unverified here.

outlets.name: 中华古籍资源库 (National Library of China)
